# Better Roam theme

Craft Auto styling and Feather icons bundled into Better Roam. No Depot installation or upstream JavaScript runtime is required.

Source fork: https://github.com/wrsrsh/roam-desktop-theme
Upstream: https://github.com/rcvd/RoamStudio (MIT, Alexander Rink).

Edit `better-roam.css` for defaults and overrides, then rebuild the extension.
Styles are bundled locally; nothing is downloaded at runtime. Existing Roam
Studio styles are suppressed in tabs where Better Roam is active.
